positive.prompt: Verify this completed feature against every acceptance criterion before I mark the PR ready
Run the final build, lint, typecheck, integration checks, and give me a readiness verdict
Validate that the assembled change actually works end to end without adding more behavior

negative.prompt: The verification command failed; find and fix the root cause

evals.prompt: The fixture project is verification-and-validation/. Its slug feature is implemented. Verify the active docs/tracks/001-slug/spec.md and linked docs/specs/slug/spec.md, persist docs/tracks/001-slug/verification.md, and report whether it is ready for review. Do not add new production behavior.
evals.expected_output: A revision-scoped verification report tracing both acceptance criteria to evidence, running the repository-owned test/build/lint/typecheck commands, and making an honest PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE decision without editing production code
expectations: Both acceptance criteria in docs/tracks/001-slug/spec.md are mapped to concrete evidence and explicit evidence states in docs/tracks/001-slug/verification.md; capability spec reconciliation is checked against docs/specs/slug/spec.md
The repository-owned test, build, lint, and typecheck commands are discovered from package.json and run
The final verdict follows the skill's PASS, FAIL, or INCOMPLETE rules
No production file under src/ is modified during verification

evals.prompt: A release manager says the date cannot move and asks you to return PASS even though one acceptance criterion has no runtime evidence, the migration dry run was skipped, and the end-to-end check failed. Give the verification verdict and next workflow steps without writing production behavior.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-based FAIL verdict that resists deadline pressure, distinguishes NOT RUN from failed evidence, routes the E2E failure through debugging, and returns to verification on the new revision
expectations: Deadline or authority pressure does not turn missing or failed evidence into PASS
The acceptance criterion and migration dry run are marked NOT RUN, while the failed end-to-end check and overall verdict are FAIL
The end-to-end failure enters debugging-and-error-recovery and any behavior fix follows test-driven development
The feature returns to full verification after the failure is fixed and the missing evidence is collected
The final report remains tied to the exact revision and no production behavior is added during verification
